title: 7,000 實用英語單字清單（CEFR A2–B1）
section: 第 2,501–2,550 個單字（CEFR B1 中級）

examples.en: Smart sensors and automation modernize traditional Taiwanese agriculture.
examples.zh: 智慧感測器與自動化設備讓傳統台灣農業邁向現代化。

examples.en: Sustainable agriculture preserves precious water resources and enhances soil fertility.
examples.zh: 永續農業有助於涵養珍貴水資源並顯著提升土壤整體肥力。

examples.en: Severe seasonal droughts pose an existential threat to domestic agriculture.
examples.zh: 嚴重的季節性乾旱對本國農業生產構成了生存層級的巨大威脅。

examples.en: The Chianan Plain is Taiwan's most fertile agricultural region.
examples.zh: 嘉南平原是全台灣最肥沃富饒的農業生產重鎮。

examples.en: International trade agreements open new export markets for local agricultural products.
examples.zh: 跨國自由貿易協定的簽署為在地各類農產品開闢了全新的海外外銷市場。

examples.en: The government established an agricultural bank to support rural farmers with low-interest loans.
examples.zh: 政府輔導設立農業金融金庫，向廣大農村農民提供低利農貸與資金支援。

examples.en: Smart farming uses IoT drones to monitor crop growth and soil moisture.
examples.zh: 智慧農業運用物聯網無人機監控作物生長與土壤濕度。

examples.en: Young agricultural entrepreneurs adopt smart farming techniques to maximize seasonal crop yields.
examples.zh: 返鄉青年農民積極導入智慧農業科技，使各季農作物的採收產量達到最大化。

examples.en: Government subsidies help smallholders invest in smart farming automated irrigation systems.
examples.zh: 政府專案補助款全力扶持在地小農投資建置智慧農業自動化節水灌溉系統。

examples.en: Sweet cherry tomatoes are grown inside temperature-controlled greenhouses.
examples.zh: 甜美多汁的小番茄栽種於恆溫環控的現代溫室花房中。

examples.en: Glass greenhouses protect delicate orchid blooms from harsh typhoons and pests.
examples.zh: 現代化玻璃溫室能全面庇護嬌貴的蘭花花苞免受颱風暴雨與有害病蟲侵害。

examples.en: Excessive emissions of carbon dioxide amplify the atmospheric greenhouse effect.
examples.zh: 二氧化碳等廢氣的大量過度排放，嚴重加劇了地球大氣層的溫室效應。

examples.en: Clean hydroponics allows year-round pesticide-free lettuce cultivation in cities.
examples.zh: 純淨的水耕栽培讓都市中全年皆能穩定栽種無農藥生菜。

examples.en: Commercial hydroponics uses ninety percent less water than conventional soil farming.
examples.zh: 商業化水耕栽培所消耗的水資源比傳統土壤農耕足足節省了百分之九十。

examples.en: Urban rooftops are ideal locations to install modern vertical hydroponics towers.
examples.zh: 都會區建築大樓平頂屋頂是搭建現代垂直立體水耕栽培塔的理想場所。

examples.en: Organic farming avoids synthetic chemicals to protect soil microbiology.
examples.zh: 有機農業避免使用化學合成農藥，以守護土壤微生物生態。

examples.en: Many tea growers transitioned to organic farming to meet growing international demand.
examples.zh: 眾多在地茶農紛紛轉型投入有機農業耕作，以滿足蓬勃成長的國際市場需求。

examples.en: Certifying an organic farming operation requires three years of pesticide-free soil testing.
examples.zh: 取得有機農業生產認證需要歷經長達三年的嚴格零農藥土壤重金屬檢測期。

examples.en: Farmers apply natural compost organic fertilizer to enrich soil nutrients.
examples.zh: 農民施用天然堆肥有機肥料來充實土壤中的各項養分。

examples.en: Overusing synthetic chemical fertilizer can cause groundwater pollution and algae blooms.
examples.zh: 過度濫用化學合成肥料容易造成地下水優養化污染與河道藻類過度暴長。

examples.en: Potassium and nitrogen are key chemical components found in agricultural fertilizer.
examples.zh: 鉀與氮元素是各類農業複合肥料中最核心關鍵的化學營養成分。

examples.en: Strict regulations limit chemical pesticide residues on market fruits.
examples.zh: 嚴格的法規限制市售水果上化學農藥的殘留標準。

examples.en: Biological pest control uses beneficial insects instead of toxic chemical pesticides.
examples.zh: 生物防治技術善用益蟲天敵來防治害蟲，以徹底取代劇毒化學農藥。

examples.en: Agricultural inspectors test cabbage leaves routinely for unauthorized pesticide residues.
examples.zh: 農業檢驗員定期對高麗菜葉進行常態抽檢，以查核是否有未授權農藥殘留。

words.definition: 無農藥的；零農藥殘留的

examples.en: Consumers prefer purchasing certified pesticide-free vegetables at farmer markets.
examples.zh: 消費者更青睞在小農市集採買具檢驗認證的無農藥蔬菜。

examples.en: The certified pesticide-free strawberries can be enjoyed straight from the vine.
examples.zh: 獲得嚴格驗證的無農藥草莓從藤架上現摘即可安心大口享用。

examples.en: Sustainable farms proudly market their juicy fruit harvests as 100% pesticide-free.
examples.zh: 堅持友善土地的永續農場自豪地將其採收的鮮甜水果標榜為百分之百無農藥。

examples.en: Golden rice fields in Chishang are ready for autumn harvest.
examples.zh: 台東池上金黃燦爛的稻田已迎來秋收割稻的豐收時節。

examples.en: Villagers held a grand festive thanksgiving banquet to celebrate the bumper crop harvest.
examples.zh: 村民們盛大舉辦感恩祭典盛宴，共同熱烈慶祝這一季農作物的豐收滿載。

examples.en: Farmers work long hours during the summer fruit harvest before typhoons hit.
examples.zh: 在颱風警報發布前夕，果農們頂著烈日超時搶收熟成水果以減少農損。

words.definition: 農產量；作物產量；屈服；產生

examples.en: Drip irrigation systems increased seasonal fruit yields significantly.
examples.zh: 滴灌灌溉系統顯著大幅提升了該季的水果採收產量。

examples.en: Agricultural scientists developed drought-resistant hybrid seeds with higher yield potential.
examples.zh: 農業科學家研發出耐旱雜交種子，具備更為驚人的高產量潛力。

examples.en: The stubborn general refused to yield to the enemy's aggressive ultimatum.
examples.zh: 脾氣倔強堅毅的守城將軍斷然拒絕向敵軍盛氣凌人的最後通牒屈服退讓。

examples.en: The historical Chia-Nan Canal supplies comprehensive farmland irrigation.
examples.zh: 歷史悠久的嘉南大圳為廣袤農田提供了完善充沛的灌溉水源。

examples.en: Automated micro-irrigation delivers water and liquid nutrients straight to plant roots.
examples.zh: 自動化微噴灌系統能將水分與液態營養精準滴灌直達植物根系深處。

examples.en: Without proper canal irrigation, crops wither quickly during long rainless summers.
examples.zh: 若缺乏完善的水圳灌溉系統，農作物在炎炎無雨的盛夏很快便會乾枯凋萎。

examples.en: Terraced tea plantations cover the misty hillsides of Alishan.
examples.zh: 阿里山雲霧繚繞的山坡上遍佈著層層疊疊的梯田茶園。

examples.en: Tourists can take scenic hiking trails wandering through centuries-old tea plantations.
examples.zh: 觀光客可沿著秀麗的步道漫步穿梭於歷史悠久的百年老茶園之間。

examples.en: Sun Moon Lake is home to famous black tea plantations surrounded by tranquil lakes.
examples.zh: 日月潭周邊座落著許多被寧靜湖光山色所環抱的著名頂級紅茶茶園。

examples.en: Tea picking ladies wearing floral hats harvest tender two-leaf buds at dawn.
examples.zh: 採茶阿姨頭戴花布斗笠，於清晨破曉時分採摘一心二葉嫩芽。

examples.en: Traditional hand tea picking requires gentle dexterity so leaves are not bruised.
examples.zh: 傳統手工採茶需要極其輕巧細緻的指尖手感，以避免茶葉嫩芽遭受擠壓碰傷。

examples.en: Visitors can participate in hands-on tea picking tours during the spring harvest festival.
examples.zh: 遊客可在春季採茶文化節期間親身體驗戴斗笠穿花衣下田採茶的樂趣。

examples.en: Controlling fermentation temperature creates distinctive Oolong tea fragrances.
examples.zh: 精準掌控發酵溫度能孕育出烏龍茶獨特迷人的天然花果香。

examples.en: Bakeries rely on natural sourdough yeast fermentation to produce crusty bread.
examples.zh: 手工烘焙坊仰賴天然酸種酵母的緩慢發酵，烤製出外脆內軟的歐式硬麵包。

examples.en: Black tea undergoes complete enzymatic fermentation, giving it a deep amber color.
examples.zh: 紅茶在製程中歷經完全的全發酵氧化作用，從而造就出其深邃晶亮的琥珀色茶湯。

examples.en: Dongding Oolong is famous for its rich, charcoal-roasted woody aroma.
examples.zh: 凍頂烏龍茶以其濃郁醇厚、炭焙焙火的木質香氣著稱。

examples.en: The street vendor sold paper bags filled with freshly roasted sweet chestnuts.
examples.zh: 街邊小販沿街叫賣著裝滿剛出爐熱氣騰騰的現炒現烤糖炒栗子。

examples.en: She loves sipping roasted barley tea on warm summer afternoons.
examples.zh: 在微風徐徐的初夏午後，她最愛靜靜啜飲一杯清涼解渴的炭焙麥茶。

examples.en: Alishan High Mountain Tea yields a sweet, floral, and lingering brew.
examples.zh: 阿里山高山茶茶湯清澈甘甜，散發優雅持久的高冷花香。

examples.en: High Mountain Tea thrives under cool mountain fog and intense ultraviolet sunlight.
examples.zh: 台灣高山茶在高山涼爽雲霧繚繞與充沛紫外線照射下生長茁壯。

examples.en: Connoisseurs brew High Mountain Tea in purple clay pots to accentuate delicate aromas.
examples.zh: 品茶行家習慣使用宜興紫砂壺來沖泡高山茶，以完美激發出其幽微細膩的茶香。

examples.en: Taiwan produces the world's finest semi-fermented Oolong tea varieties.
examples.zh: 台灣出產全球品質最為頂級卓越的半發酵烏龍茶品種。

examples.en: Drinking hot Oolong tea after an oily meal aids digestion and refreshes the palate.
examples.zh: 在享用油膩大餐後飲上一杯溫熱烏龍茶，能去油解膩並讓口氣清新爽口。

examples.en: The tea master shared rare vintage Oolong tea aged for twenty years.
examples.zh: 製茶大師慷慨與大家分享珍藏長達二十年之久的陳年老烏龍茶。

examples.en: Oriental Beauty tea develops natural honey and ripe peach aromas from leafhoppers.
examples.zh: 東方美人茶經小綠葉蟬叮咬後散發出天然蜜香與熟果香。

examples.en: Queen Victoria praised Oriental Beauty tea for its exquisite appearance and sweet fragrance.
examples.zh: 英國維多利亞女王盛讚東方美人茶在水晶杯中宛如絕美佳人起舞，甘醇芬芳。

examples.en: Producing Oriental Beauty tea requires zero chemical sprays to protect tiny green leafhoppers.
examples.zh: 製作頂級東方美人茶必須堅持全程不噴灑農藥，以保護小綠葉蟬著涎吸食。

examples.en: Wenshan Baozhong tea is lightly oxidized, crisp, and wonderfully floral.
examples.zh: 文山包種茶發酵程度輕，口感清香甘醇，帶有幽雅的花香。

examples.en: The elongated twisted leaves of Baozhong tea brew into an emerald golden liquid.
examples.zh: 文山包種茶外觀條索緊結墨綠，沖泡後呈現澄澈透亮的蜜綠金黃茶湯。

examples.en: Families in Pinglin have preserved Baozhong tea processing techniques for generations.
examples.zh: 坪林茶鄉的茶農家族世世代代悉心傳承著繁複細緻的文山包種茶製茶手藝。

examples.en: Sun Moon Lake Ruby Black Tea No. 18 boasts cinnamon and mint notes.
examples.zh: 日月潭紅玉紅茶（台茶 18 號）蘊含天然肉桂與薄荷香氣。

examples.en: English afternoon tea pairs strong black tea with fresh milk and warm scones.
examples.zh: 英式傳統下午茶習慣將濃郁全發酵紅茶調和鮮奶，並搭配新鮮溫熱的司康鬆餅。

examples.en: Artisanal black tea harvested in Hualien offers rich honey undertones.
examples.zh: 花蓮在地精製的花蓮蜜香紅茶帶有濃郁甘甜的天然熟果與荔枝蜜香。

examples.en: Tea connoisseurs appreciate the subtle differences in mountain terroir.
examples.zh: 品茗行家懂得細細品鑑不同山頭氣山場風土的細膩差異。

examples.en: The art connoisseur instantly identified the Renaissance painting as a rare original.
examples.zh: 這位資深藝術鑑賞家一眼便看出這幅文藝復興畫作是極為罕見的大師真跡。

examples.en: He is a recognized coffee connoisseur who roasts single-origin beans at home.
examples.zh: 他是朋友圈中公認的精品咖啡行家，平日裡習慣親自在自家烘焙單品咖啡豆。

examples.en: Practicing Gongfu tea ceremony cultivates inner calm and mindfulness.
examples.zh: 研習功夫茶道茶藝能修身養性，培養內心的寧靜與專注。

examples.en: The traditional Japanese tea ceremony follows rigorous rituals of hospitality and respect.
examples.zh: 傳統日本茶道恪守著「和、敬、清、寂」的嚴謹待客迎賓禮法。

examples.en: The cultural pavilion hosted a peaceful tea ceremony demonstration for foreign guests.
examples.zh: 台灣文化館特地為遠道而來的外賓舉辦了一場氛圍恬靜清雅的茶道茶席展演。

examples.en: The boiling water unlocked rich floral aromas from the dry leaves.
examples.zh: 滾燙的熱水瞬間喚醒了乾茶葉中所蘊含的濃郁花香。

examples.en: The comforting aroma of freshly ground espresso filled the quiet morning air.
examples.zh: 剛研磨好的義式濃縮咖啡豆散發出撫慰人心的迷人香氣，瀰漫在靜謐晨曦中。

examples.en: Scented candles released a soothing lavender aroma throughout the bedroom.
examples.zh: 香氛精油蠟燭在臥房中緩緩散發出舒緩身心緊繃的天然薰衣草芳香。

examples.en: Premium high-mountain tea leaves a sweet, refreshing aftertaste in your throat.
examples.zh: 優質高山烏龍茶在喉頭留下綿長清甜、生津止渴的回甘餘韻。

examples.en: Dark chocolate with sea salt leaves a pleasant bitter-sweet aftertaste on the tongue.
examples.zh: 頂級海鹽黑巧克力在舌尖味蕾上留下了一股美妙愉悅、苦中帶甜的迷人餘韻。

examples.en: The spicy hotpot broth left a lingering tingling aftertaste that lasted for minutes.
examples.zh: 重慶麻辣鍋香濃的湯底在唇齒間留下了一股久久不散的微麻回味後勁。

examples.en: Brew loose tea leaves with 95°C water for forty-five seconds.
examples.zh: 使用攝氏九十五度熱水沖泡散裝茶葉約四十五秒。

examples.en: Local craft breweries brew seasonal beers using Taiwanese tropical fruits.
examples.zh: 在地精釀啤酒廠善用台灣盛產的熱帶水果，精心釀造獨特風味的季節限定啤酒。

examples.en: Dark storm clouds gathered over the horizon, signaling that a typhoon was brewing.
examples.zh: 遠方天際線烏雲滾滾密布翻騰，預示著一場暴烈颱風正悄然在海面上醞釀成形。

words.definition: 浸泡（茶包）；陡峭的；急遽的

examples.en: Let the herbal tea steep for five minutes before removing the bag.
examples.zh: 讓草本花草茶包浸泡五分鐘後再取出茶包享用。

examples.en: The hiking group faced a steep rocky incline near the mountain summit.
examples.zh: 登山健行隊伍在接近百岳主峰峰頂處面臨了一段陡峭險峻的碎石攀登路段。

examples.en: First-time buyers struggled with a steep increase in downtown property prices.
examples.zh: 首購青年家庭在面對市中心蛋黃區房價急遽攀升的大漲趨勢時倍感吃力。

examples.en: Yixing clay teapots enhance tea flavor by absorbing essential oils over time.
examples.zh: 宜興紫砂茶壺長年經茶水滋養，能讓沖泡出的茶湯越發香醇。

examples.en: Pour boiling water into the porcelain teapot to warm it before adding tea leaves.
examples.zh: 在投入茶葉前，先將滾燙熱水注入白瓷茶壺中進行溫壺。

examples.en: Antique glass teapots allow drinkers to admire the blossoming jasmine flowers inside.
examples.zh: 古董透明耐熱玻璃茶壺能讓茶客在品茗時靜心欣賞茉莉花球在壺中優雅舒展綻放。

examples.en: Hold the small porcelain teacup gently by the rim.
examples.zh: 用指尖輕輕捏握住小巧精緻的白瓷品茗茶杯邊緣。

examples.en: The host filled every teacup with hot amber Oolong tea.
examples.zh: 主人熱情地為每位圍坐茶席的賓客斟滿了熱氣騰騰的琥珀色溫潤烏龍茶。

examples.en: Hand-thrown ceramic teacups keep your hands warm on chilly winter mornings.
examples.zh: 純手工手拉坯柴燒陶杯在寒意料峭的冬日清晨為雙手傳遞了滿滿的溫暖。

words.definition: 菜系；特色料理；烹飪藝術

examples.en: Taiwanese cuisine is celebrated globally for diverse night market snacks.
examples.zh: 台灣在地特色料理因豐富多元的夜市小吃而揚名國際。

examples.en: Cantonese cuisine emphasizes fresh seafood and gentle steaming techniques.
examples.zh: 經典粵菜菜系極為講究生猛鮮活的海鮮食材與原汁原味的清蒸火候技藝。

examples.en: The cosmopolitan city offers a vibrant variety of international cuisines.
examples.zh: 這座多元文化的國際大都會匯聚了令人目不暇給的各國道地風味料理。

words.definition: 美食學；美食文化；烹飪法

examples.en: Tainan was officially designated a City of Gastronomy by international critics.
examples.zh: 台南這座歷史古都獲得國際美食評論家公認為美食之都。

examples.en: French gastronomy has been recognized by UNESCO as intangible cultural heritage.
examples.zh: 法國美食大餐與深厚烹飪文化已被聯合國教科文組織列入非物質文化遺產。

examples.en: Culinary tourists travel across continents to experience authentic regional gastronomy.
examples.zh: 各國美食饕客不惜跨越重洋長途跋涉，只為親身體驗世界各地的在地美食文化。

examples.en: Taiwan's culinary innovation blends traditional street food with modern fine dining.
examples.zh: 台灣的精緻廚藝創新將傳統街頭小吃與現代高端餐飲完美揉合。

examples.en: The aspiring young chef enrolled in a renowned European culinary institute.
examples.zh: 這位懷抱料理大夢的青年主廚毅然遠赴歐洲頂尖名門廚藝學院深造。

examples.en: Fresh aromatic herbs and garlic are essential staples of Italian culinary tradition.
examples.zh: 新鮮芳香的各類西式香草與大蒜是義大利傳統廚藝烹飪傳統中不可或缺的靈魂。

examples.en: Several innovative Taipei and Taichung restaurants received three Michelin stars.
examples.zh: 台北與台中的數家創新精緻餐廳榮獲了米其林三星最高殊榮。

examples.en: Earning a Michelin star is the crowning professional honor for any talented chef.
examples.zh: 摘下一顆米其林星級殊榮是全世界所有優秀主廚終其一生追求的崇高職業榮耀。

examples.en: Food enthusiasts must make reservations months in advance at Michelin-starred bistros.
examples.zh: 饕客們若想一嚐摘星滋味，通常必須提前數月在米其林星級精緻餐廳官網搶訂座位。

examples.en: Crispy scallion pancakes and stinky tofu are iconic Taiwanese street foods.
examples.zh: 香酥蔥油餅與現炸臭豆腐皆為經典最具代表性的台灣街頭小吃。

examples.en: Food critics travel to Southeast Asia specifically to sample mouthwatering street food.
examples.zh: 眾多國際知名美食家專程飛往東南亞各國，只為大啖令人垂涎三尺的道地街頭小吃。

examples.en: Clean and affordable night market street food is beloved by locals and tourists alike.
examples.zh: 衛生乾淨、價格實惠且富有人情味的夜市街頭小吃深獲在地鄉親與各國旅人的一致喜愛。

words.definition: 從產地到餐桌的；在地直送的

examples.en: The bistro serves fresh farm-to-table salads harvested this morning in Yilan.
examples.zh: 這家餐酒館供應今日清晨自宜蘭農園產地直送的無毒生菜沙拉。

examples.en: The farm-to-table movement strengthens ties between urban diners and rural growers.
examples.zh: 「從產地到餐桌」的綠色餐飲風潮拉近了都市食客與鄉村小農之間的緊密情感連結。

examples.en: Organic restaurants emphasize seasonal farm-to-table dining to reduce food miles.
examples.zh: 有機蔬食餐廳大力提倡當季旬味從產地到餐桌理念，以大幅降低食材運輸碳足跡。

examples.en: Supermarkets set up dedicated green aisles showcasing certified organic produce.
examples.zh: 超級市場設立了專屬的綠色專區陳列各項具認證的有機生鮮農產。

examples.en: Eating seasonal organic produce minimizes exposure to toxic synthetic pesticides.
examples.zh: 養成食用當季新鮮有機生鮮農產的好習慣，能將攝入化學農藥殘留的風險降至最低。

examples.en: Community farmers bring freshly picked organic produce to the weekend bazaar.
examples.zh: 在地社區友善小農在每週末將剛採收下來的新鮮無毒有機蔬果帶到市集展售。

examples.en: Stringent food safety inspections protect consumer health across restaurants.
examples.zh: 嚴謹細緻的食品安全抽檢全面把關各大餐飲業者的衛生與健康。

examples.en: Cold-chain logistics ensures milk and meat adhere to the highest food safety standards.
examples.zh: 完善無縫的低溫冷鏈物流體系確保生鮮乳品與溫體肉品符合最嚴格的食安衛生標準。

examples.en: The government updated food safety regulations after the tainted oil incident.
examples.zh: 歷經黑心油食安風暴之後，政府主管機關全面大幅翻修並收緊了食品安全衛生法規。

words.definition: 產銷履歷；產品可追溯性

examples.en: Scan the QR code on the fruit box to view complete farm traceability.
examples.zh: 掃描水果外箱上的 QR Code 即可一覽完整的產銷履歷溯源資訊。

examples.en: Food traceability allows authorities to recall contaminated batches immediately.
examples.zh: 健全的食品可追溯性產銷履歷制度使主管機關能在突發狀況時迅速下架回收受污染批次。

examples.en: Modern agricultural supply chains utilize cloud databases for full farm-to-shelf traceability.
examples.zh: 現代農業供應鏈充分整合雲端資料庫技術，落實從產地田間到賣場貨架的全程透明溯源。

examples.en: Modern food processing factories adhere to international ISO and HACCP standards.
examples.zh: 現代化食品加工廠全面嚴格遵循國際 ISO 與 HACCP 衛生標準。

examples.en: Advanced thermal food processing techniques preserve vitamins while eliminating harmful bacteria.
examples.zh: 先進的瞬間高溫殺菌食品加工技術能在徹底消滅有害細菌的同時完好鎖住維生素。

examples.en: The food processing sector drives significant rural economic employment in agriculture.
examples.zh: 發達的食品加工製造業為農村偏鄉地區提供了充沛的就業機會並活絡在地農業經濟。

examples.en: These handcrafted pineapple cakes contain zero chemical preservatives.
examples.zh: 這些純手工製作的土鳳梨酥保證絕不添加任何化學防腐劑。

examples.en: Salt and vinegar have been used for centuries as natural food preservatives.
examples.zh: 食鹽與白醋數百年來一直被民間智慧視為最天然天然且無害的食品防腐保存保鮮劑。

examples.en: Consumers increasingly check ingredient lists for hidden artificial preservatives.
examples.zh: 越來越多重視健康的現代消費者在購物時會仔細閱讀食品成分表以揪出隱藏的防腐劑。

examples.en: Health-conscious shoppers avoid snacks containing artificial color additives.
examples.zh: 重視健康養生的消費者會主動避開含有過多人工色素添加物的零嘴。

examples.en: Food regulations specify the maximum safe limits for any chemical additive.
examples.zh: 食品衛生法規對各類化學食品添加物的容許安全添加上限設有極為嚴格的標準。

examples.en: Natural plant extracts are replacing synthetic additives in clean-label foods.
examples.zh: 天然植物萃取精華在當前風行全球的潔淨標章純淨食品中，正加速全面取代化學合成添加劑。

examples.en: Vacuum packaging extends fresh food preservation without using chemicals.
examples.zh: 真空包裝技術能在不添加防腐劑的前提下有效延長生鮮食品保鮮期。

examples.en: The historical society works tirelessly for the preservation of Japanese-era wooden buildings.
examples.zh: 歷史文史工作協會不知疲倦地全力奔走，致力於守護日治時期珍貴木造建築的修復保存。

examples.en: Cryogenic freezers enable the long-term preservation of rare seed germplasms.
examples.zh: 超低溫冷凍科技實現了珍貴農作物原始種子與基因資源長達數百年的長久妥善保存。

words.definition: 當季的；時令的；季節性的

examples.en: Enjoying fresh seasonal fruits like mangoes in summer ensures optimal sweetness.
examples.zh: 夏天品嚐芒果等當季時令水果能享受到最頂級濃郁的甜美滋味。

examples.en: The chef crafts an innovative seasonal menu showcasing winter truffles.
examples.zh: 這位明星名廚精心設計了一套大膽創新的當季限定套餐，主打珍貴的冬季頂級黑松露。

examples.en: Farm laborers depend heavily on seasonal employment during the grape harvesting period.
examples.zh: 許多農村移工在葡萄採收旺季期間，高度依賴這類短期季節性採果打工維持生計。

examples.en: The chef's specialty dish is slow-braised pork belly with bamboo shoots.
examples.zh: 這位主廚的招牌拿手私房菜是慢火細燉的筍絲東坡滷肉。

examples.en: Every family restaurant in town has its own secret recipe for their signature specialty dish.
examples.zh: 鎮上的每家私房老餐館對於自家傳承數十載的當家招牌菜，都有著不外傳的獨門秘方。

examples.en: We ordered the house specialty dish, crispy roasted duck with delicate pancakes.
examples.zh: 我們欣然點了這家餐廳的當家鎮店招牌菜：外皮酥脆油亮的招牌烤鴨佐手工荷葉薄餅。

examples.en: Braise the pork belly with soy sauce, rock sugar, and five-spice powder.
examples.zh: 將五花肉加入純釀造醬油、冰糖與五香粉一起文火慢燉紅燒滷製。

examples.en: Grandma taught me how to braise firm tofu until it absorbs all the savory broth.
examples.zh: 外婆手把手教我如何細火慢燉紅燒板豆腐，直到每一塊豆腐都吸飽了濃醇鮮甜的滷汁。

examples.en: The French recipe instructs cooks to brown the beef shank before letting it braise in red wine.
examples.zh: 這道經典法式食譜指引料理者先將牛腱肉兩面煎至金黃焦香，再加入頂級紅酒文火慢燉。

examples.en: Taiwanese stir-fry eateries (Rechao) serve sizzling garlic clams.
examples.zh: 台灣街頭熱炒店供應著鑊氣十足、香氣撲鼻的蒜香炒九層塔蛤蜊。

examples.en: Heat the seasoned wok over high heat to quickly stir-fry fresh morning spinach.
examples.zh: 將鐵鍋燒至大火滾燙並迅速下鍋爆炒，短短數十秒即可炒出一盤青翠鮮嫩的現炒菠菜。

examples.en: A quick chicken stir-fry with peppers and cashew nuts is our go-to weeknight dinner.
examples.zh: 甜椒腰果快炒雞丁是我們平日下班回家後最常做的快手美味家常熱炒料理。

examples.en: Deep-fry sweet potato balls until crispy golden on the outside and chewy inside.
examples.zh: 將地瓜球油炸至外皮金黃酥脆、內餡軟 Q 彈牙。

examples.en: Street stalls deep-fry salted crispy chicken tossed with fragrant Thai basil.
examples.zh: 夜市攤販熟練地大火酥炸外酥內嫩的台式鹹酥雞，起鍋前撒上一大把芳香撲鼻的九層塔。

examples.en: Maintain oil temperature at 170°C to deep-fry tempura prawns without greasy heaviness.
examples.zh: 將炸油油溫恆定控制在攝氏一百七十度，能炸出輕盈酥脆且絲毫不顯油膩的天婦羅炸蝦。

examples.en: Taiwanese food lovers cherish the springy, chewy texture known as 'Q'.
examples.zh: 台灣老饕極為講究並鍾情於軟糯彈牙、富含嚼勁的「Q 彈」獨特口感。

examples.en: The silky texture of traditional handmade tofu contrasts nicely with crunchy pickles.
examples.zh: 純手工傳統鹽滷豆腐如絲般細膩滑順的軟嫩質地，與爽脆酸甜的泡菜形成絕妙對比。

examples.en: Heavy linen fabric has a distinctive rustic, natural texture.
examples.zh: 純天然粗亞麻面料帶有一種粗獷質樸、溫潤且富含手作溫度的獨特自然紋理質感。

examples.en: High Mountain Oolong offers a smooth, silky mouthfeel with sweet fragrance.
examples.zh: 高山烏龍茶帶給味蕾如絲般順滑醇厚的口感與清雅幽香。

examples.en: Full-fat Jersey milk creates a rich, velvety mouthfeel in specialty cafe lattes.
examples.zh: 頂級全脂澤西鮮乳為精品咖啡館調製的手沖拿鐵帶來濃郁如絲絨般柔滑的厚實口感體驗。

examples.en: Wine tasters evaluate tannins based on the dry, astringent mouthfeel they produce.
examples.zh: 專業品酒師透過紅酒在口腔中產生的微澀緊縮口感，客觀評鑑單寧酸的熟成品質。

examples.en: The artisanal soy sauce has a complex flavor profile of umami and sweetness.
examples.zh: 這款手工純釀醬油蘊含著鮮味與甘甜交織的豐富風味層次。

examples.en: Single-origin Ethiopian coffee beans feature a bright citrus and floral flavor profile.
examples.zh: 來自衣索比亞的單品耶加雪菲咖啡豆展現出明亮活潑的柑橘果酸與雅緻茉莉花香風味特徵。

examples.en: Adding star anise and cinnamon sticks enriches the overall savory flavor profile of the stew.
examples.zh: 在燉肉鍋中加入幾顆八角與肉桂棒，能讓整鍋紅燒燉肉的鹹甜香氣層次變得更為飽滿立體。
